_about: Sentence templates for everything Oriel states about a sign. Oriel fills the slots itself; key facts NEVER go through machine translation, so a route number or a place name cannot be changed by a translation model. 'says_*' templates are only used for CONFIRMED facts, 'looks_*' for uncertain ones. 'simple' holds the Explain-simpler version. Telugu and Hindi are drafts: check with native speakers.

_review.te: DRAFT - check with a Telugu speaker
_review.hi: DRAFT - check with a Hindi speaker

says_route_to.hi: बोर्ड पर लिखा है: बस {route}, {place} के लिए।

looks_route.en: The bus number looks like {route}, please check.
looks_route.hi: बस नंबर {route} लग रहा है, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।
looks_route.te: బస్సు నంబర్ {route} లా ఉంది, దయచేసి సరిచూసుకోండి.

simple.en: Maybe bus {route}. I am not sure. Please ask someone.
simple.hi: शायद बस {route}। पक्का नहीं। किसी से पूछ लीजिए।
simple.te: బహుశా బస్సు {route}. ఖచ్చితంగా తెలియదు. ఎవరినైనా అడగండి.

route_unreadable.en: I can read {place} but not the bus number.
route_unreadable.hi: {place} पढ़ पा रहे हैं, लेकिन बस नंबर नहीं।

simple.en: {place}. I cannot read the bus number.

looks_place.hi: यह {place} लग रहा है, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।

simple.en: Maybe {place}. I am not sure. Please ask someone.
simple.hi: शायद {place}। पक्का नहीं। किसी से पूछ लीजिए।

looks_platform.en: The platform looks like {platform}, please check.
looks_platform.hi: प्लेटफ़ॉर्म {platform} लग रहा है, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।

looks_arrow.en: The arrow looks like it points {direction}, please check.
looks_arrow.hi: तीर {direction} लग रहा है, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।

looks_direction.en: It looks like {place} is {direction}, please check.
looks_direction.hi: लगता है {place} {direction} है, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।

looks_traffic_sign.en: This looks like a {sign} sign, please check.
looks_traffic_sign.hi: यह {sign} का संकेत लग रहा है, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।

signal_walk.en: The crossing signal appears to show the walking figure. Still, listen to the traffic before you cross.
signal_walk.hi: पैदल सिग्नल पर चलने का निशान दिख रहा है। फिर भी पार करने से पहले ट्रैफ़िक ध्यान से सुनिए।
signal_walk.te: పాదచారుల సిగ్నల్‌పై నడిచే గుర్తు కనిపిస్తోంది. అయినా దాటే ముందు వాహనాల శబ్దం జాగ్రత్తగా వినండి.

signal_dont_walk.en: The crossing signal appears to show stop. Do not cross yet.
signal_dont_walk.hi: पैदल सिग्नल पर रुकने का निशान दिख रहा है। अभी पार मत कीजिए।
signal_dont_walk.te: పాదచారుల సిగ్నల్‌పై ఆగమనే గుర్తు కనిపిస్తోంది. ఇప్పుడే దాటకండి.

signal_changing.en: The signal seems to be changing. Wait for the next walk signal.
signal_changing.hi: सिग्नल बदलता हुआ लग रहा है। अगले चलने के सिग्नल का इंतज़ार कीजिए।
signal_changing.te: సిగ్నల్ మారుతున్నట్టుంది. తదుపరి నడిచే సిగ్నల్ కోసం వేచి ఉండండి.

signal_unclear.en: I can't tell what the crossing signal shows. Please ask someone before crossing.
signal_unclear.hi: पैदल सिग्नल साफ़ नहीं दिख रहा। पार करने से पहले किसी से पूछ लीजिए।
signal_unclear.te: పాదచారుల సిగ్నల్ స్పష్టంగా కనిపించడం లేదు. దాటే ముందు ఎవరినైనా అడగండి.

signal_countdown.hi: उलटी गिनती में लगभग {value} सेकंड दिख रहे हैं।

looks_text.en: It looks like it says {text}, please check.
looks_text.hi: लगता है लिखा है: {text}, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।

looks_shop_name.en: The shop name looks like {name}, please check.
looks_shop_name.hi: दुकान का नाम {name} लग रहा है, कृपया जाँच लीजिए।
looks_shop_name.te: షాపు పేరు {name} లా ఉంది, దయచేసి సరిచూసుకోండి.

probably_open.en: So it is probably open now.
probably_open.hi: इसलिए यह शायद अभी खुला है।
probably_open.te: కాబట్టి ఇది ఇప్పుడు బహుశా తెరిచి ఉంది.

probably_closed.en: So it is probably closed now.
probably_closed.hi: इसलिए यह शायद अभी बंद है।
probably_closed.te: కాబట్టి ఇది ఇప్పుడు బహుశా మూసి ఉంది.

open_sign.hi: खुला है का बोर्ड लगा है।

closed_sign.hi: बंद है का बोर्ड लगा है।

advertisement_unknown.hi: यह एक विज्ञापन लग रहा है।

sign_unclear.en: I can see a sign but cannot read it clearly.
sign_unclear.hi: बोर्ड दिख रहा है, लेकिन साफ़ पढ़ नहीं पा रहे।

table_info.en: There is a table on the sign. {text}

route_digit_style._about: How route numbers are spoken. 'native' uses digit_words in the user's language, 'english' uses English digit words for everyone (many Hyderabad riders say bus numbers in English). Ask your testers.

letter_names._about: Latin letters in route numbers (10H, 219D) spelled in the user's script so Telugu and Hindi voices do not skip them.

hours_words._about: Used to say shop timings in each language. Periods: morning 5-11, afternoon 12-15, evening 16-19, night 20-4.
